description: The integration CORE and the task's primary verification gate: the publish pipeline (admin-client.ts, publish-transform.ts, validation.ts) that converts CMS content to the engine config shapes and pushes it THROUGH the admin HTTP API only (create connection/jdm/flow -> validate(stored {flowId,version:N}) -> publish), plus the flow-canvas <-> engine-Node-tree serializer (the UI-side half of the transform), plus the full vitest+nock test suite from design §6.1/§6.2/§6.3. Depends on FEAT-002 (content-type shapes) and FEAT-001 (harness). All bodies are FLAT (env="" top-level, no wrapper), carry Authorization: Bearer, and secret_ref only.
steps: types/ shared TS types (cms/types/engine.ts): the engine config shapes and the FLAT wire bodies verified against the as-built Go structs — createFlowRequest {env,flowId,method,path,tree,fixtures?,note?}; setActiveRequest {env,version}; createJDMRequest {env,jdmId,doc,version}; createConnectionRequest {env,key,type,settings,secretRef,resilience}; validateFlowRequest stored {env,flowId,version}; GET /admin/connections response with Go-cased resilience {Timeout(ns),Retry:{MaxAttempts},Breaker:{...}}. Recursive engine Node tree {id,type,spec,children?}.

publish-transform.ts (cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/publish-transform.ts) per §5.2 — PURE functions: flowToEnginePayload(entry,env) -> flat {env,flowId,method,path,tree,fixtures} (tree passes through with mixed casing preserved; fixtures map to {name,input,mocks?,expect?} omitting absent mocks/expect); jdmToEnginePayload(entry,env) -> flat {env,jdmId,doc,version:0}; connectionToEnginePayload(entry,env) -> flat {env,key,type,settings,secretRef,resilience} where resilience is Go-cased ns {Timeout:<ns>,Retry:{MaxAttempts}} (timeoutMs ms -> Timeout ns; retry.maxAttempts -> Retry.MaxAttempts) and the fn THROWS a TransformError if any settings key matches the denylist (password,pwd,secret,token,apikey,dsn). No flow/connection wrapper, no stray top-level fields.

admin-client.ts (cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/admin-client.ts) per §5.1 — typed native-fetch wrapper configured from env/Environment (ADMIN_API_BASE_URL global, Environment.adminApiBaseUrl override; token from ADMIN_API_OPERATOR_TOKEN or operatorTokenRef, read at call time, never persisted/logged). Methods: createFlow, validateFlow (STORED mode body {env,flowId,version} only), publishFlow, rollbackFlow, createJdm, createConnection, listConnections, dryRunFlow, audit. Every request sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and env=payloadEnv (default ""). Treat 200 ok:false as blocked; map 422/409/404/403/401/5xx per the §5.5 table.

validation.ts (cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/validation.ts) + publish controller (controllers/publish.ts) + beforePublish lifecycle wiring per §5.3/§5.4 — orchestrate the ordered sequence: env=payloadEnv; (1) listConnections then createConnection for only missing/changed keys (reconcile: compare authored settings keys with driver defaults filled, resilience ns->ms normalized, err toward re-create when inconclusive); (2) createJdm per referenced jdm (create==activate, write back engineVersion from createJdm().version); (3) createFlow (write back engineVersion from createFlow().version); (4) validateFlow stored {env,flowId,version:N} — if transport/5xx OR ok:false OR 404: BLOCK (abort), store lastValidation, set lastPublishStatus=failed, do NOT call publishFlow; (5) on ok:true, publishFlow {env,version:N} (handle 422/403 aborts); set lastPublishStatus=published. The transform's secret-denylist throw aborts BEFORE any admin call.

flow-canvas serializer (cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/components/FlowCanvasField/serialize.ts, pure, no React import) per §4.2 — canvas {nodes,edges}+layout -> engine recursive Node tree walked from the trigger root, emitting operation.{Kind,Payload,Required} CAPITALIZED and all other spec keys camelCase (condition trueKey/falseKey, set targetPath/from, decision jdmId/input/saveAs, action connection/saveAs); and the inverse (tree -> canvas) keeping x/y in a sidecar layout map. Export both directions for round-trip testing. (The React FlowCanvasField component itself is FEAT-004; this feature delivers only the pure serializer + its test.)

vitest + nock test suite under cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/ and the serializer test alongside serialize.ts, implementing design §6.1/§6.2/§6.3: see acceptance_criteria for the exact assertions. Remove the FEAT-001 placeholder test once real tests exist.
acceptance_criteria: §6.1 transform: flowToEnginePayload reproduces the seed.json trees for fmc-order-by-id and orders-expedite preserving mixed casing, emits flat body with NO flow wrapper and no stray top-level fields; fixtures omit absent mocks/expect; jdmToEnginePayload always sets version:0; connectionToEnginePayload emits Go-cased ns resilience (authored timeoutMs ms converted to Timeout ns) and THROWS on a seed-style dsn and on any denylist key.

§6.2 serializer: canvas->tree->canvas round-trip over the seed trees preserves branch keys, nesting, and control-node children; a naive all-camelCase serialization FAILS the casing assertion (operation.{Kind,Payload,Required} capitalized).

§6.3 happy path: nock asserts the EXACT order listConnections -> createConnection(only changed) -> createJdm -> createFlow -> validateFlow(stored {env:"",flowId,version:N}) -> publishFlow({env:"",version:N}); every request carries Authorization: Bearer <token>; NO body carries a flow/connection wrapper; write-backs read distinct keys (engineVersion from createFlow().version and createJdm().version, active pointer from publishFlow().activeVersion).

§6.3 BLOCKING (the three mandated gates): a 200 ok:false validation failure, an unreachable validator (validateFlow -> 503), AND a detected inline secret (transform throws) EACH block publish with ZERO createFlow calls where applicable and ZERO publishFlow calls (nock interceptors assert zero hits); lastPublishStatus=failed and lastValidation stored where relevant. Secret case asserts zero admin HTTP calls at all.

§6.3 additional status cases pass: validate 404 (re-create, non-recoverable, publish not called), publish 422 un-validated (abort, keyed to 422 NOT 409), create route-collision 409 (author-fixable copy, validate/publish not called), under-privileged 403 (non-recoverable, no retry), reconcile does NOT re-create a connection whose GET response differs only by driver defaults + Go-cased ns resilience, rollback calls POST /admin/flows/{id}/rollback with {env:"",version}.
`npm run test` runs the whole suite GREEN; `npm run build` still succeeds.
